title: Claude Code Mobile Skills, Plugins, and MCP
summary: Amol Pomane maps skills, project instructions, plugins, and MCP servers to distinct jobs in a mobile agent stack, then gives a concrete native iOS combination using XcodeBuildMCP, Maestro, and Sentry. The guide calls out context cost, telemetry settings, device-control tradeoffs, and Maestro's optional AI assertion as sources of hidden failure or false confidence.
takeaway: Keep project facts in AGENTS.md, load judgment through focused skills, add live tools only when needed, and treat optional AI assertions and telemetry defaults as explicit review decisions.
